en.name: Gravy in jars and cans
en.summary: Ready-made gravy in a jar or can is commercially sterilised, which is why an unopened one keeps about 2–5 years from purchase in the cupboard. Once opened it is an ordinary meat-based leftover with 1–2 days in it — a much shorter window than most people expect from a jar.
en.pantry: Unopened, about 2–5 years from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard, away from the hob and out of the sun. The sealed jar or can is doing all the work, so nothing else is required. Discard without opening any can that is bulging, leaking, rusted through or badly dented along a seam — a failed seal on a low-acid, meat-based product is not something to gamble on, and reheating does not undo it.
en.fridge: Once opened, transfer the gravy out of the can into a sealed container, keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and use it within 1–2 days. That is short because gravy is a thick, low-acid, meat-based liquid — the same profile as any other meat leftover, and thicker, so it cools and reheats unevenly. Cool it fast in a shallow container, and reheat only what you need, to a full rolling boil, stirring as it goes.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is given for jarred or canned gravy, and it is a poor candidate anyway: starch-thickened, meat-based sauces separate on thawing and come back watery or grainy, needing whisking and often re-thickening. Given how short the fridge window is, the practical answer is to open the size of jar that matches the meal. If you do freeze some, use a rigid container with headspace at −18 °C (0 °F) and expect to work on the texture.
en.thawing: Thaw frozen gravy in the fridge, or reheat it straight from frozen in a covered pan over low heat, whisking as it loosens. Bring it to a full boil before serving; never thaw it on the counter.
spoilage: A bulging, leaking or badly rusted can — discard it unopened
A film, mould or ropy strands in stored gravy
Fizzing or spurting when the jar is opened
tips: Decant out of the can into a sealed container as soon as it is opened.
Buy the jar size that matches the meal — the opened window is only a day or two.
Cool leftovers fast in a shallow dish, not in the jug they were served from.
Reheat to a full boil, stirring, rather than warming through.

faq.q: How long does jarred gravy last once opened?
faq.a: 1–2 days in a sealed container in the fridge at 4 °C or below. It is a meat-based leftover, not a condiment.

faq.q: How long does an unopened jar of gravy keep?
faq.a: About 2–5 years from purchase in a cool dry cupboard, provided the container is undamaged.
No timeline is given and it separates on thawing. If you do, use a rigid container with headspace and expect to whisk it back together.

faq.q: Why is opened gravy so short-lived compared with other jars?
faq.a: Because it is a low-acid, meat-based liquid with no salt, sugar or vinegar preserving it — quite unlike a pickle or a ketchup.

zh.name: 罐裝肉汁醬
zh.summary: 罐裝或瓶裝的現成肉汁醬經過商業殺菌，所以未開封放櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 2～5 年。一旦開封，它就是一般的肉類剩食，只有 1～2 天——比多數人對「一罐醬」的預期短得多。
zh.pantry: 未開封從購買日起算大約 2～5 年，放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃、遠離爐火與日曬。所有保存工作都由密封的罐體完成，不需要額外處理。罐身鼓起、滲漏、鏽穿或接縫嚴重凹陷的，不要開，直接丟掉——低酸性的肉類製品密封失效不值得冒險，再加熱也救不回來。
zh.fridge: 開封後請把醬移出罐頭、裝進密封容器，放 4 °C 以下，並在 1～2 天內用完。這麼短是因為肉汁醬是濃稠、低酸、以肉為基底的液體——和其他肉類剩菜同一種性質，而且更濃稠，降溫和回熱都更不均勻。請用淺容器快速降溫，每次只加熱要用的份量，並邊攪邊煮到大滾。
zh.freezer: 罐裝肉汁醬沒有提供冷凍期限，而且本來就不適合：以澱粉勾芡的肉基底醬汁解凍後會分離、出水或變粗，需要重新攪打甚至重新勾芡。既然冷藏窗口這麼短，實際的答案是依這一餐的需求選罐子大小。真的要冷凍，請用硬質容器留膨脹空間放 −18 °C，並預期要花工夫調整質地。
zh.thawing: 冷凍肉汁醬請放冷藏解凍，或直接蓋鍋小火從冷凍加熱，邊化邊攪。上桌前要煮到大滾；絕對不要放室溫解凍。
spoilage: 罐身鼓起、滲漏或嚴重生鏽——不要開，直接丟掉
聞起來發酸或有發酵味
保存的醬出現薄膜、霉或絲狀黏稠
tips: 一開封就把內容物移到密封容器。
依這一餐的需求選罐子大小——開封後只有一兩天。
剩下的用淺盤快速降溫，不要留在上桌的醬汁壺裡。
回鍋要邊攪邊煮到大滾，不要只是加溫。

faq.q: 罐裝肉汁醬開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 移到密封容器放 4 °C 以下冷藏 1～2 天。它是肉類剩食，不是一般調味料。

faq.q: 未開封的罐裝肉汁醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 只要容器完好，陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃從購買日起算大約 2～5 年。

faq.q: 剩下的肉汁醬可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 沒有提供期限，而且解凍後會分離。真要冷凍請用硬質容器留膨脹空間，並預期要重新攪打。

faq.q: 為什麼開封後的肉汁醬比其他罐頭短那麼多？
faq.a: 因為它是低酸、以肉為基底的液體，沒有鹽、糖或醋在保存它，和醃菜或番茄醬完全不同。
